title: Open decisions for Tom
summary: 1 Registrations: LDAP holds what a service means, emergency services.txt the local copy. 2 Local client path: unix socket /run/xtpd.sock, root and a named group, fd passing. 3 Name: xtpd. 4 Fence expiry in DEGRADED and below: protected-class peerages keep firewall entry and keys until hard key expiry, every hold logged; NORMAL strict. 5 Workstation path to cats1: through ed209k, or XTP over UDP. 6 Parachute without port 22: redeploy, or a serial-console root login. 7 Witness placement: ed209k is 14.7 ms from cats1 and 126.9 ms from cats2. These are Claude's suggestions, not decisions.
authority: design (architecture Tom Dyer; written by Claude (Opus 5.5), 2026-11-24)
invariants: None of these is decided until Tom says so
procedure: Ask Tom; do not build on a suggestion as if decided
